newsitem.title: DENMARK: Political upset damps Danish stock trade.
newsitem.headline: Political upset damps Danish stock trade.

text.p: Danish share prices closed slightly higher on Monday. But trade was subdued by worries about government proposals to tax pension-linked personal equity gains, and by the U.S. election upheaval, dealers said.

"It wasn't easy to flush out a buyer on today's market and I think it will be similar tomorrow. The U.S. election tomorrow evening will put a further damper on the market so we'll end up about the same (as today)," a chief trader said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 0.03 point to 125.26 in overall bourse turnover of 574 million crowns.
The KFX December future rose 0.30 point to 125.50 with 108 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
On a rather desultory day with focus on non-KFX paper, Tele Danmark finished one crown up at 289 and Novo Nordisk shed two crowns to 960. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
